# Authored retained-artifact fixtures

These public fixtures contain no camera metadata. `before.xmp` has three exact
OwnerName occurrences: one attribute and two elements. `derivative.xmp` deletes
only the first element; two occurrences remain. `absent.xmp` has none. This
manual occurrence oracle is independent of the reporting parser. The report text
contains deliberately false caller claims and must remain opaque.

RAW/preview fixtures are created in memory by the repository's independently
authored structural generator. These are parser controls, not real-media or
independent format qualification. Slots/hashes bind declared bytes and names;
they do not prove custody or enumerate unknown external artifacts.
